limitations: Simulated-user results are heuristic regressions, not usability or demand evidence.

experiment.baseline: The controlled corpus exposes ten evidence-admitted moments; no measured-user baseline exists.
experiment.target: 100% deterministic fixed-flow integrity; expected moment appears in the top three; zero timestamp landing error.
experiment.stopRule: Stop if any result lacks validated rights or exact source-time routing.
experiment.noDataBoundary: No measured users, usability, demand, or revenue evidence exists.
